tips.discoverSwipeBody: Swipe the card right to like and left to skip. The buttons below do the same.
tips.discoverPlayBody: Tap play to hear 30 seconds of the song. The ring around it shows how much has played.
tips.discoverLikedBody: Everything you like shows up in Liked songs, just below, and improves the next suggestions.
tips.vibeNewTypeBody: A vibe can be a photo, video, text or song. Tap the buttons below to choose.
tips.vibeNewTextBody: Tap the vibe to write, then pick a font, color and background. Tap somewhere else to add more texts and drag each one into place.
tips.vibeNewTimeBody: The vibe is visible for 24 hours and then disappears. You can see who viewed it.
tips.vibeViewBody: Tap the right side for the next one and the left side to go back. Hold the screen to pause.

ads.introBody: Every now and then you'll see a post or a vibe labeled Sponsored. Ads are not chosen using your profile, your tastes or what you do in the app.
